enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket to chest. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow under head. Keep eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Shift legs. Remain lying. Keep eyes closed. Turn to back. Place arms on blanket. Remain still. Sleep.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Sit on toilet. Urinate. Stand up. Press flush button. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub soap on hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe hands. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator door. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator door. Place items on counter. Open cabinet door. Take out bowl and plate. Close cabinet door. Place bowl on counter. Open bread bag. Take out two slices. Place slices on plate. Open milk carton. Pour milk into bowl. Close milk carton. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl and plate. Walk to sink. Place bowl and plate in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open wardrobe door. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe door. Place clothes on bed. Remove sleepwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Put down comb. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Pick up work bag. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

Walk out of house. Close front door. Lock front door with key. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to workplace building. Open building door. Walk inside. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to department entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter department. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Place bag inside. Close locker. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with paper towel. Put on gloves. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Open door. Greet patient: Good morning, how are you feeling? Check patient name band. Measure blood pressure.

Walk out of workplace building. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to house. Open front door. Walk inside. Close front door. Lock front door with key. Walk to Bedroom 1. Place bag on bed. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner (using microwave, avoiding induction cooker due to peak request)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator door. Take out dinner container. Close refrigerator door. Open microwave door. Place container inside microwave. Close microwave door. Press microwave start button. Open microwave door. Take out container. Close microwave door. Open drawer. Take out fork. Sit at table. Eat dinner with fork. Drink water. Stand up and place container and fork in sink. Walk past induction cooker without pressing its power button. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to Living Room. Sit on sofa. Pick up TV remote. Press TV power button. Press channel button. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll phone screen. Put down phone. Pick up laptop. Open laptop lid. Press laptop power button. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Watch TV. Close laptop lid. Put down laptop. Pick up TV remote. Press TV power button. Stand up. Walk out of Living Room.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Open shower curtain. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Turn off shower tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to Bedroom 1. Turn off bedroom light. Pull back blanket. Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Pull blanket to shoulder. Keep eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain lying. Keep eyes closed. Remain still. Sleep.
